items.t: Engine stalls without warning while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling and repair module or wiring fault
items.note: Owner-reported costs average about $1,500. Check open recalls first; those repairs are free.

items.t: 4.7L V8 can stall from engine computer software (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Knee can bump the key and shut off the engine (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Ignition key can slip out of Run while driving (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Transfer case can slip into neutral (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Front control module can stall the engine or kill the wipers (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Sunroof drain tubes leak water inside
items.job: Clear and reattach sunroof drain tubes
items.note: Water-damaged headliners or wiring cost extra.

items.t: Interior door handles crack or snap
items.note: Dealers may quote a whole door panel ($800 or more); aftermarket handle kits are much cheaper.

items.t: Dash lights and headlights blink or gauges act up
items.job: Test charging system and replace integrated power module if faulty
items.note: A loose ground or bad battery is a much cheaper fix, so test those first.

items.t: Hemi dropped valve destroys the engine
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured 5.7L
items.note: Owner-reported costs average about $4,250; dealer quotes ran $8,000-$10,000.

items.t: Third-row seat belts can be cut by the retractor bracket (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: ABS software can delay or lock the brakes (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Front brake caliper can crack (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Driver airbag wiring reversed (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Key can come out before shifting to Park (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Rear track bar problem (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Brake pedal can disconnect from booster (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Wheel bearing hum or growl
items.job: Replace wheel hub and bearing assembly
items.note: Price is per wheel.

items.t: Engine won't crank or start
items.job: Diagnose no-start and replace ignition node or starter

items.t: Service 4WD light or four-wheel drive engaging on its own
items.job: Diagnose and repair transfer case shift motor, sensor or module
items.note: Owner-reported repairs average about $3,700 when the transfer case itself is replaced.

items.t: Rust under the windshield trim
items.job: Remove windshield, repair rust and reinstall glass
items.note: Owner-reported costs average about $1,800.

items.t: Power window stops or falls
